quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: At a four-way stop, you should let another driver go first if they:

options.text: Are on your left.
Got there before you.
Are across from you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Got there before you.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles should go in the order they arrive. The first car to arrive goes first. If two cars arrive at the same time, the car on the right goes first.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Pump the brake pedal quickly several times.
Let the car slow down on its own without using the brakes.
Press the brake pedal down as hard as you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car slow down on its own without using the brakes.
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, hold the steering wheel tight and keep the car straight. Take your foot off the gas. Do not use the brakes hard. Let the car slow down by itself. Use the brakes gently only if you need to. Pull off the road when it is safe.

questions.question: Crashes are more likely to happen when:

options.text: All cars are driving at about the same speed.
One lane is moving faster than other lanes.
One car is moving faster or slower than the other cars around it.

questions.correctAnswerText: One car is moving faster or slower than the other cars around it.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen more often when one driver goes faster or slower than other cars on the road. Driving faster than traffic increases crash risk. Driving slower than traffic is also dangerous because it can cause a rear-end crash or make other drivers swerve.

questions.question: If you see water flooding the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Brake hard.
Turn around and take a different route.
Drive only down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn around and take a different route.
questions.explanation: Never drive through flooded water. Even shallow water can hide dangers. If you see water on the road, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is:

options.text: Allowed from the side with the solid yellow line.
Not allowed from either side.
Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allowed from the side with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When one yellow line is broken and one is solid, you can pass from the broken line side. You cannot pass from the solid line side.

questions.question: On a highway with a single broken white line, you:

options.text: Cannot cross the line to pass.
May cross the line to pass and change lanes.
May cross the line only to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: May cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Sharp left and right turns ahead.
Winding road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: Which is NOT safe on the highway?

options.text: Slower traffic stays in the right lane.
Change lanes without signaling.
If you miss your exit, go to the next exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes without signaling.
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic. Do not back up or turn around on the highway. If you miss your exit, go to the next one.

questions.question: Truck blind spots are:

options.text: Directly behind the truck.
On the immediate left side of the cab.
On the immediate left side and directly behind the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the immediate left side and directly behind the truck.
questions.explanation: Trucks have large blind spots. The driver cannot see your car behind them or to the left of the cab. If you cannot see the driver's face in their mirror, they cannot see you.

questions.question: You should leave extra space when following:

options.text: A station wagon.
A driver who cannot see behind their vehicle.
A small passenger car.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver who cannot see behind their vehicle.
questions.explanation: Drivers of trucks, buses, vans, or vehicles with trailers cannot see cars directly behind them. Keep extra distance from these vehicles. Large vehicles also block your view ahead, so stay back to see around them.

questions.question: What effect does a blood alcohol concentration of 0.02 percent have?

options.text: It has no effect on driving.
It does not put other drivers at risk.
It doubles your chances of having an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: It doubles your chances of having an accident.
questions.explanation: Each 0.02 percent increase in blood alcohol concentration nearly doubles a driver's risk of being in a fatal crash.

questions.question: What should you do if your tire blows out?

options.text: Tap or pump the brakes.
Slow down gradually and brake lightly.
Press the brakes hard and quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually and brake lightly.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, take your foot off the gas and slow down gradually. Do not use the brakes until the vehicle has slowed down considerably.

questions.question: How should you park your vehicle on a hill?

options.text: One of your rear wheels should touch the curb.
Use your parking brake and put the vehicle in park.
Point your front wheels parallel to the road if there is no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your parking brake and put the vehicle in park.
questions.explanation: Always use your parking brake and leave your vehicle in park when parked on a hill. If there is no curb, turn your front wheels away from the center of the road in case the brakes fail. If there is a curb, point your wheels toward it when heading downhill, or away from it when heading uphill.

questions.question: What is the only effective way to remove alcohol from your body?

options.text: Drink strong coffee.
Wait for time to pass.
Take a cold shower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for time to pass.
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body. Eating, drinking coffee, or taking a shower will not speed this up.

questions.question: What does a steady red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points after you stop.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A steady red arrow means traffic cannot go in that direction. You must come to a full stop and wait for a green signal before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Stop completely at the stop line, at the crosswalk, or before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe and you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When is it safe to return to your lane after passing a vehicle?

options.text: When the driver you passed signals for you to return.
When you signal for three seconds.
When you see the passed vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see the passed vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Make sure you have enough space before returning to your lane. When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to safely change lanes.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in a construction zone?

options.text: Speed up slightly.
Expect anything to happen.
Expect construction workers to get out of your way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect anything to happen.
questions.explanation: Construction zones have unexpected conditions. Drive with extra caution to protect yourself, other drivers, and construction workers.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to follow a motorcycle too closely?

options.text: Motorcycles do not follow the same rules as other vehicles.
Motorcycles can stop much faster than regular vehicles.
Motorcycles brake more slowly than regular vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorcycles can stop much faster than regular vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles stop quickly. If you follow too closely, you cannot avoid a crash if the motorcyclist makes a mistake. You need enough space and time to react.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Divided highway.
Railroad warning.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What do rumble strips do?

options.text: They warn drivers about tire problems.
They test a vehicle's shock absorbers.
They use vibration and sound to warn drivers that they are leaving the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They use vibration and sound to warn drivers that they are leaving the road.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips make noise and vibration to alert drowsy or distracted drivers that they are drifting off the road or approaching a stop sign or traffic signal.

questions.question: When do large trucks usually lose speed?

options.text: Going up long or steep hills.
Driving through long, gradual curves.
Going down long, gradual hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Going up long or steep hills.
questions.explanation: Large trucks accelerate slowly. They lose speed when going up long or steep hills. Leave extra space behind trucks, especially on hills.

questions.question: When is a U-turn not allowed?

options.text: In a parking lot.
On or near a curve or hill.
On a straight road where you can see 500 feet ahead in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near a curve or hill.
questions.explanation: Never make a U-turn on or near a curve or hill. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians clearly, which could cause a crash.

questions.question: What must you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Wait for the green light.
Slow down and cross carefully.
Stop before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and stay alert. Watch for other cars and pedestrians before crossing.

questions.question: When can you go at a red light with a green arrow?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
After you wait for the light to change.
When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction if you are in the right lane and the road is clear. This is true whether the arrow appears alone or with other lights.
